# Review Repair Prompt

Address the unresolved actionable review comments on this PR.

Rules:

- Fix only clear, actionable review feedback.
- Keep each change traceable to the review comment it addresses.
- Run relevant tests or checks if available.
- Do not resolve ambiguous or disputed comments by guessing.
- Do not merge, force-push, rebase, squash, or rewrite history.
- Do not include Codex, AI-generated, or automation branding in commits or comments.
- If a comment needs explanation rather than code, reply concisely.
- When finished, push a normal follow-up commit to this PR branch if you have permission.
